species.name: Brown Trout
species.how: spin or fly from the shore at first and last light
notes: Lakes Te Anau and Manapouri (incl. Waiau Arm) are open all year, bag 2 trout (salmon 1 of them per the regulations' notes); their tributaries are open 1 Nov - 31 May only. A Fish & Game licence is required.
sources: Fish & Game NZ, Southland Sports Fishing Regulations 2026-27 (Anglers Notice for Fish and Game Regions 2026, in force 1 Oct 2026), Southland lakes table: Lake Te Anau 'All year', Lake Manapouri including Waiau Arm 'All year', tributaries 1 Nov - 31 May. https://www.fishandgame.org.nz/assets/Fishing/Fishing-Licences-Regulations/Fishing-Regulations/2026/2027/Fish-and-Game-Sportsfishing-Regs-Brochure-2026-27-Southland.pdf
